[[File:HoloEntertainmentTable.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A holographic performance on an entertainment table]]
'''Holo-entertainment tables''' were a type of table which displayed [[entertainer]]s in a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] performance.<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawaroo]] was known to enjoy this form of entertainment.<ref name="SWHS">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Holo-entertainment tables were decorative items in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="AED" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
